text:
one tricky thing about navigating life that I’d pass onto someone younger, is that you will get the best advice from people one-on-one behind closed doors

both the good and bad outcomes of whatever paths you’re considering

the phrase I’ve used that seems to resonate with people is that “everything in life has trade-offs”

what happens otherwise is that you follow this sort of broad “society” voice which is generally people who are programmed…just repeating what they were told “do this, do that” but if you ask them - WHY do you believe what you do? - you’d get a blank stare in return

the risk here is that you blindly follow a path that either runs against your instinct, or where you just have no inclination at all…because what happens is when you get there, and you then turn to society and ask, “what now?”

they’ll snap back at you - “why the fuck are you asking me?? I have my own problems, my own bills to pay” etc

and it’s very easy to feel like you got played, in some sense…you blindly followed a path to nowhere. That shit will make you feel like a coward.

The best thing that can happen is to recognize this at a young age - hence this tweet - before you’ve “opened too many doors that can’t be closed”….or gone too far down a path that just ain’t YOU. 

There’s no avoiding that everything in life has tradeoffs, the best you can do is get informed about them and you’re most likely to get “THE REAL” from somebody else one on one…seek that out, and treat everything else as suspect. 

there are many paths but only one is right for you. good luck 🛣️
